events.title: CHH Q1 Deep Dive: Revenue Beat Overshadowed by Margin Compression and Guidance Reaffirmation
events.body: Hotel franchisor Choice Hotels (NYSE:CHH) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 2.3% year on year to $340.6 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.07 per share was 18.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
